fix(transport): answer immediate frames in order

A frame answered beside the turn is now chained onto the answers its
socket is still owed: the pong of a ping sent after a list_sessions is
written only once that list has gone out, so a later answer can no
longer overtake an earlier one. That write race is what CI's red run
showed on the acceptance file - a bare list_sessions was answered, but
its session_list lost the race against the ping sent right behind it and
the ask came back with none - and it is pinned at the handler level by
answers a ping sent after a pending list once that list is answered, in
arrival order, cited to the new statement in the protocol spec's 4.3,
with the nine citations its insertion shifted re-pointed by hand. Frames
still never wait on the lock, so a list answers mid-turn as before.

The same push repairs CI's typecheck finding: the list_sessions limit
refusal is a limit-is-number predicate now, so the frame's limit narrows
and validation.ts compiles, validation.test.ts staying green over it.

Refs re-cinq/HALEngine#144

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
